spec_lineage_nvme_base.summary: Initial NVMe Base. PCIe register-level interface. Submission Queue + Completion Queue with up to 65,535 I/O queues. 64-byte command + 16-byte completion. PRP descriptors. Admin Command Set + NVM Command Set.
Added SGL support, Autonomous Power State Transition, Multi-Path I/O / Namespace Sharing (Section 8 expanded). Reservations Command Set Specific. End-to-end Protection clarifications.
Added Namespace Management & Attachment, Controller Memory Buffer (CMB), Host Memory Buffer (HMB), Live Firmware Activation, Telemetry Log, Streams. Restructured controller config.

Added Boot Partitions, Sanitize, Directives (Streams Directive Type 01h), Virtualization Enhancements (SR-IOV), Device Self-Test, Telemetry Host-/Controller-Initiated. Added Doorbell Buffer Config for emulation.

Added Persistent Memory Region (PMR), Asymmetric Namespace Access (ANA), Endurance Groups, NVM Sets, Predictable Latency Mode, Get LBA Status, Rebuild Assist, IO Determinism, Read Recovery Level, NVMe-MI integration extensions.

spec_lineage_nvme_over_fabrics.summary: Defines NVMe over Fabrics: RDMA (RoCE / iWARP / InfiniBand) + Fibre Channel transports. Adds Capsule format, Connect command, Property Get/Set, Discovery service.
Adds TCP transport binding, additional Discovery extensions.

spec_lineage_nvme_mi.summary: Management Interface for NVMe; defines SMBus / PCIe VDM / MCTP transports for out-of-band management.
Adds Enclosure Management, additional health monitoring.

key_changes.summary: SGL — adds Scatter Gather List support (controller-optional, default still PRP for PCIe).
CMB / HMB / NSMgmt — adds Controller Memory Buffer (BAR-mapped controller-local memory) + Host Memory Buffer (DRAM borrow) + namespace create/delete.
Boot Partitions + Sanitize + SR-IOV + Self-Test + Telemetry. Major enterprise/data-center push.

PMR (Persistent Memory Region) + ANA (Asymmetric Namespace Access) + Endurance Groups + NVM Sets + Predictable Latency Mode + Get LBA Status + IO Determinism. Storage-class memory and dual-port multipath.

backward_compat_traps.rule: VS reports controller's compliant version; higher-version OS must gracefully handle lower-version controllers.
backward_compat_traps.trap: OS that assumes 1.4 features (PMR, ANA, Get LBA Status) on a 1.0 controller will see Invalid Field in Command (SC=0x02) or hit unimplemented register reads returning 0.

backward_compat_traps.rule: If CAP.CSS bit 44 = 1, controller only supports Admin Command Set; host shall set CC.CSS = 111b.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Driver expecting NVM Command Set on every controller will fail on Admin-only controllers (e.g. some discovery / management controllers).

backward_compat_traps.rule: Host must configure MSI-X table BEFORE setting CC.EN=1 if using MSI-X; using INTMS/INTMC while MSI-X is enabled has undefined results.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Mixing INTMS write with MSI-X-enabled controller silently corrupts interrupt delivery.

backward_compat_traps.rule: CC.IOSQES must match Identify Controller SQES.RECOMMENDED (4..6); same for CC.IOCQES.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Mismatched entry sizes cause Create I/O SQ/CQ to fail with command-specific status.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Default doorbell stride is 4 bytes (CAP.DSTRD=0); some controllers report larger stride.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Driver hard-coding 4-byte stride will write to the wrong queue's doorbell.

backward_compat_traps.rule: After CC.EN=0→1, all CQEs have Phase Tag P=0; host expects first newly-posted CQE to have P=1 (controller inverts).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Driver that assumes P=1 on the first pass (e.g. by-analogy from older specs) will deadlock waiting.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Host must Create I/O CQ first; Create I/O SQ that references a non-existent CQ returns Invalid Queue Identifier (SC=0x01).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Buggy ordering during multi-queue setup silently leaves SQs orphaned.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Host must Delete all I/O SQs attached to a CQ before Delete I/O CQ; otherwise SC=0x0C Invalid Queue Deletion.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Resource-leak path when reconfiguring queue topology mid-run.

backward_compat_traps.rule: PRP entries within a PRP List must have zero Offset; only PRP1 (and PRP2 when serving as PBA) may have non-zero offset.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Driver bug constructing PRP List with non-zero offsets returns SC=0x13 PRP Offset Invalid.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Admin commands over PCIe must use PRP (PSDT=00b); SGL is mandatory for NVMe over Fabrics.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Code shared between PCIe + Fabrics that uses SGL for Admin on PCIe gets SC=0x11 SGL Descriptor Type Invalid.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Fused First (FUSE=01b) and Fused Second (FUSE=10b) must be adjacent in the same SQ.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Driver that doesn't enforce adjacency gets SC=0x0A Command Aborted due to Missing Fused Command.

backward_compat_traps.rule: Not all commands accept NSID=FFFFFFFFh broadcast; check Identify Controller / per-command spec.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Driver that always broadcasts gets SC=0x0B Invalid Namespace or Format on unsupported commands.

fields.version_naming_history_note: NVMe is managed by NVM Express, Inc., a 501(c)(6) industry association founded in 2009 (announced 2011). The first Base 1.0 spec was authored by Intel + 80+ industry partners. The version cadence has been roughly every 2 years for Base. NVMe-oF (Over Fabrics) and NVMe-MI (Management Interface) are sister specifications. NVMe 2.0 (May 2021, after this Base 1.4 doc) restructured the spec family into Base + per-Command-Set specs + per-Transport bindings.
